reviews.comment: Very good but fast. His accent isn't bad enough to be unintelligible. Examples are useful for paper.  She talks through the concepts step by step in a very clear and concise manner.

reviews.comment: This class is so easy, just guest speakers, and you dont even have to go. You have 3 assignments the entire semester. Assign 1: write about some jobs you might want to pursue. Assign 2: write a report about the profs article he wrote. Assign 3: write a report on 3 of the guest speaker presentations. All are probably just completion grades anyway

He will 100% be the best professor you will have, especially in a subject like Project Risk Management or even Research. He has a way of simplifying what would usually be complex and intimidating concepts to something anyone can do. He loves statistics, data, and aims to merge statistical analysis to develop construction management solutions.

Easily the most accommodating and respectable professor I've had at Texas A&M. Truly cares about his students and will 100% work with you if you need any extensions or help. The class itself is heavy as there are worksheets, learning modules, homework, projects, and midterms but overall basically impossible to not get an A. Take him for sure!

Dr. D is definitely one of the best professors at TAMU. He is very interested in the success of his students and has a clear passion for the material, which makes it easier to learn. Additionally, he is extremely supportive, encouraging, and patient. Whenever I needed help, he is always there. I would miss his classes next year.

Best professor I've had in my 4 years at TAMU. He actually reads all your assignments and gives you real feedback, it's honestly refreshing. His classes are very entertaining and his notes are AMAZING for the test. It's not too hard but you really have to try to not make an A with him honestly. Find a way to get into any of his classes.

Dr. Damnjanovic is a legend in the CVEN department. He is a great professor and shows so much respect for all of his students. He is very knowledgeable as a professor of practice and he keeps up with industry trends, so he is a great resource. On top of that, he is very funny and likes to give out assignments that brighten your day. Amazing prof!

reviews.comment: Taking CVEN 644 and CVEN 710 with Dr. Damjanovic was an amazing experience. He does have a little accent but is completely understandable. Has grest real life experiences and stories to share with you as the class progresses. He loves statistics, probability, and data. I would definitely take his class again if got chance.
